state.goal: Find a strong free compiler lecture series on YouTube

found.text:
The search didn’t surface a relevant university compiler-course playlist; results were mostly unrelated YouTube help pages. ([help.youtube.com](https://help.youtube.com/support/youtube/bin/answer.py?answer=57792))
Sources:
[s1] Create & manage playlists - Computer - YouTube Help — https://help.youtube.com/support/youtube/bin/answer.py?answer=57792

Stanford’s official CS143 course page is here: ([web.stanford.edu](https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs143/?C=S%3BO%3DD)) I couldn’t confirm an official YouTube playlist for the lectures; the course page has Stanford’s lecture materials. ([web.stanford.edu](https://web.stanford.edu/class/archive/cs/cs143/cs143.1128/))
Sources:
[s2] CS143: Compilers — https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs143/?C=S%3BO%3DD
[s3] CS143: Compilers — https://web.stanford.edu/class/archive/cs/cs143/cs143.1128/
